hypothesis: Unmapped geothermal conduit faults are marked up-gradient of kinetically disequilibrated well/spring chemistry: distal outflow sites (Tcat-Tqtz>=25C, Tqtz-Tout>=40C, Tcat>=110C) point along +grad(det_elev) streamlines to a blind conduit gated by isostatic gravity horizontal-gradient basement steps, while proximal near-equilibrated sites (Tq>=100C, -40<=Tcat-Tqtz<=15C) mark conduits at the site.
mechanism: Catalogue-free UGBP surfaces (proximal isotropic sigma=9px; distal isotropic control sigma=9px; distal streamline-advection 3-80px step 3px decay exp(-t/35px); gated = upgradient*(0.25+0.75*rank(iso_grav_anom_hg))) are canaried alone, then fused as 4 features into a HistGradientBoosting hide-and-recover learner (24 frozen features) trained only on an inner simulated hide of the visible catalogue; dotted greedy emission min_sep=2.8px, >2px off visible catalogue (holdout) / full catalogue (final), budget 37654, binary 1.0 dots, shared submission_writer zeros-outside.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lateral thermal groundwater plumes in permeable alluvial-fan channels and agricultural irrigation-return wells; falsified if up-gradient advection does not beat the distal-isotropic control.
site_aggregation: median per (row,col) over rows at the site
